exactCase.title: Ni, Ni, Ni!
exactCase.evidenceScope: Single cold search and native Audio playing/start, muted. Synthetic benchmark catalog IDs. Not a full-song or acoustic match claim.

differences.native: Bundled audio/webm before audio/mp4; measured Ni used itag251.
differences.pwa: AAC before Opus; Opus requires canPlayType. Up to four native-metadata probes run concurrently but are awaited in quality order.
differences.portable: Codec preference is ordinary web logic; preserve actual browser codec support and existing AAC fallback tests.

differences.native: Fetches target watch+embed, exact ID and made-for-kids eligibility; derives current per-video public client, visitor, flags, playerJS, analyzer-matched timestamp.
differences.pwa: Neutral anonymous M7lc1UVf-VE embed recipe is static build-time data prepared on 2026-10-23.
differences.portable: Pure parsing and binding are portable; reading current remote HTML/player requires measured browser CORS access or a build-time recipe refresh. Do not infer a native result from a Node-only fetch.

differences.native: Preserves opaque rollout version plus published client_extra whitelist.
differences.pwa: Current recipe already contains deviceExperimentId, rolloutToken, configInfo and platform/browser/region fields.
differences.portable: Already represented; not a missing context-field fix.

differences.native: SelectiveAnalyzer + versioned DeclarationHistory + DeferredDependencies + filteredTimestampMatcher; separate parser/execution bundles, source/hash/ABI cache. Pinned youtubei18.1.0 and Meriyah7.4.0.
differences.pwa: Build-time youtubei18.2.0 analyzer produces the static extracted fragment. Runtime processValues follows the same nsigFunction/deferred-method/sig+n algorithm in a bounded isolated Worker.
differences.portable: Pure JS execution logic is portable and already equivalent. Parser performance specializations must not be copied across pinned dependency versions without equivalence tests.

differences.native: Retries incomplete embed parsing once; early SABR-only preparation can replace changed configuration/decoder once, under original deadline and at most two POSTs. A byte-identical request is not reissued as fresh.
differences.pwa: No runtime discovery/recipe renewal for SABR-only responses; source refresh reruns the same static recipe.
differences.portable: Pure coordination is portable only when fresh public configuration is actually available; preserve cancellation and identity binding.

differences.native: Strict readable 206 Range at80%, exact Content-Range/length, identity encoding and complete1024-byte body. First candidate retry slots0,250,1000,1500(optional until2000),2000,3000,4000,5000,6000; global8s and10dispatches; observed429 stops.
differences.pwa: Muted HTMLAudio metadata probes at0,500,1500,3500,6000, <=4 candidates in parallel; no readable HTTP headers/body.
differences.portable: Cadence/budgets/cancellation are web-portable. Audio seek/decode deeper into a file can test media availability but must not be called equivalent to Rust exact HTTP-envelope validation.

differences.native: reqwest controls Origin, User-Agent, client headers and visitor header; readable watch/embed/player and strict CDN ranges.
differences.pwa: Sandbox opaque browser context sends ordinary POST text/plain without cookies; browser controls Origin and transport.
differences.portable: Same ID/body must be measured in the actual browser. No claim of impossibility or guaranteed success based only on native availability or CORS assumptions.

recommendedNextGate: Fresh neutral build-time recipe; exact NGp3dh-hBe8 browser canary including healthy AAC and native-supported Opus candidates, duration/deeper seek/background boundaries reported separately. Do not add a per-song mapping or claim a full-song result from the Native prefix test.
